item.text:
**5B.1 Research Note**

Bottom line: **mostly no**. Khamenei’s 2024 public line still centered on domestic production and some charitable patronage, but the year’s concrete political/economic behavior and election management point much more toward legitimacy maintenance, hardline control, and short-term regime survival than toward broad-based, sustainable prosperity.

| Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level summary | QIDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| Martyr Ayatollah Khamenei | KHAMENEI.IR / @Khamenei_en (Telegram) | 2024-03-20 | https://t.me/s/Khamenei_en/4952 | Khamenei’s New Year message said the key to fixing Iran’s economic problems was domestic production and, in the same March 20 Telegram material, included a charitable contribution for needy prisoners. This is the clearest pro-prosperity signal I found, but it is mainly rhetoric and discretionary patronage, not a structural program for broad-based sustainable prosperity. | 5B.1 |
| Iran rulers seek big turnout in election amid mounting discontent | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-03-01 | https://theprint.in/world/iran-rulers-seek-big-turnout-in-election-amid-mounting-discontent/1984836/ | Reuters framed the parliamentary vote as a legitimacy test amid economic woes and restrictions on political and social freedoms. Khamenei urged turnout to “make friends happy and disappoint enemies,” which reads more like legitimacy management than prosperity-building. | 5B.1, 4B.1, 4B.10 |
| Iran vote turnout hits historic low amid discontent | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-03-02 | https://theprint.in/world/iran-vote-turnout-hits-historic-low-amid-discontent/1986385/ | Reuters said turnout fell to about 41 percent, the lowest since 1979, and tied the election to economic woes, sanctions, mismanagement, and corruption. That is strong evidence that the regime was not delivering broad-based economic performance or durable public buy-in. | 5B.1, 4B.1, 4B.10 |
| Iran’s presidential election dominated by Khamenei loyalists | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-06-25 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/irans-presidential-election-dominated-by-khamenei-loyalists-3494879 | Reuters reported a tightly controlled contest in which the Guardian Council approved only five hardliners and one low-profile moderate from 80 applicants, with Khamenei’s preferred camp dominating. That looks like loyalty preservation and regime consolidation, not an attempt to maximize sustainable prosperity. | 5B.1, 4B.1, 4B.2, 4B.8 |
| Khamenei protege, sole moderate neck and neck in Iran presidential race | Reuters via Swissinfo | 2024-06-29 | https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/khamenei-protege%2C-sole-moderate-neck-and-neck-in-iran-presidential-race/82029064 | Reuters said voter apathy was driven by economic hardships and social restrictions, and that hardline candidates avoided concrete economic plans even while acknowledging the crisis. That is the strongest evidence that the system was prioritizing short-term control over serious prosperity reform. | 5B.1, 4B.1 |

**Search gap**
- I found no reliable 2024 evidence that Khamenei pursued a durable, broad-based prosperity strategy through institutional reform, anti-rent extraction, or credible economic liberalization.
- The strongest positive material was rhetorical and charitable, not structural. The rest of the 2024 record points to managed legitimacy and hardline control amid economic decline.
